title: BYD wins round one in Defender-copycat battle as JLR is told to destroy documents
summary: BYD just got some good news in its Defender-copycat court battle with JLR. After JLR had BYD’s Netherlands offices raided and documents seized, a Dutch court has now handed BYD an early win, ordering JLR to destroy the documents or face a penalty. more…

title: Kia is giving the EV5 an update, and leaked images show what’s next
summary: Kia isn’t wasting any time updating its Sportage-sized EV5 electric SUV. Leaked images just gave us our first look at what’s changing. more…

title: Lunar’s new home DC fast charger puts your EV battery to work
summary: Lunar Energy has unveiled a 25-kW home DC fast charger that will do more than just power up your car really fast. Paired with its next-generation home battery system, the Lunar Fast Charger will also let a compatible EV help keep the house running during an outage and potentially earn money by sending electricity back to the grid. more…

title: sonnen’s new smart breakers help your home battery last longer
summary: A home battery can do more during a blackout if it isn’t busy running nonessential, energy-hungry appliances. sonnen and SOLRITE Energy are putting that same principle to work for the grid, adding smart breakers that can temporarily switch off selected household loads while batteries help meet electricity demand. more…

title: SpaceX could announce $1.5 trillion Tesla merger in December: report
summary: Elon Musk’s companies are moving faster than expected on a Tesla-SpaceX combination. A deal could be announced as soon as December, which would make it the largest merger ever, according to Bloomberg . Tesla holds its annual shareholder meeting on December 3, and the same directors who would sign off on the deal are up for re-election. more…
